items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, did Mineta, a manual day. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I know he was there for a while, he didn't stay that long.
